entries.title: Leviticus 4:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 4:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD [concerning things] which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

words.text: [concerning things] which ought not to be done

entries.title: Leviticus 4:3
segments: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:4
segments: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:5
segments: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.title: Leviticus 4:6
segments: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:7
segments: And the priest shall put [some] of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which [is] in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which [is at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:8
segments: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards,

entries.title: Leviticus 4:9
segments: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

words.text: that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks

entries.title: Leviticus 4:10
segments: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:11
segments: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

entries.title: Leviticus 4:12
segments: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt. {without...: Heb. to without the camp} {where...: Heb. at the pouring out of the ashes}

words.text: . {without...: Heb. to without the camp} {where...: Heb. at the pouring out of the ashes}

entries.title: Leviticus 4:13
segments: ¶And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done [somewhat against] any of the commandments of the LORD [concerning things] which should not be done, and are guilty;

words.text: [concerning things] which should not be done

entries.title: Leviticus 4:14
segments: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:15
segments: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:16
segments: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

entries.title: Leviticus 4:17
segments: And the priest shall dip his finger [in some] of the blood, and sprinkle [it] seven times before the LORD, [even] before the vail.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:18
segments: And he shall put [some] of the blood upon the horns of the altar which [is] before the LORD, that [is] in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which [is at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:19
segments: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn [it] upon the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:20
segments: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

words.text: for them, and it shall be forgiven

entries.title: Leviticus 4:21
segments: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it [is] a sin offering for the congregation.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:22
segments: ¶When a ruler hath sinned, and done [somewhat] through ignorance [against] any of the commandments of the LORD his God [concerning things] which should not be done, and is guilty;

words.text: [concerning things] which should not be done

entries.title: Leviticus 4:23
segments: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

entries.title: Leviticus 4:24
segments: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it [is] a sin offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:25
segments: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:26
segments: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

words.text: for him as concerning his sin

entries.title: Leviticus 4:27
segments: ¶And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth [somewhat against] any of the commandments of the LORD [concerning things] which ought not to be done, and be guilty; {any one: Heb. any soul} {common...: Heb. people of the land}

words.text: [concerning things] which ought not to be done
; {any one: Heb. any soul} {common...: Heb. people of the land}

entries.title: Leviticus 4:28
segments: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:29
segments: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:30
segments: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:31
segments: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn [it] upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

words.text: for him, and it shall be forgiven

entries.title: Leviticus 4:32
segments: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:33
segments: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 4:34
segments: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

entries.title: Leviticus 4:35
segments: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

words.text: , according to the offerings made by fire
